name: work-tracker
description: Frontend of the work tracker: TypeScript in src/templates/ts, compiled with tsc to src/templates/static/js.

scripts.api-types: pipenv run python -m src.utils.openapi && npx --yes -p openapi-typescript@7.13.0 -p typescript@5.9 openapi-typescript src/templates/openapi.json -o src/templates/ts/api-types.ts --default-non-nullable false
